# Totem Avatar

**Turn your Totem of Undying into a tiny version of *you*.**

Totem Avatar rebuilds the Totem of Undying as a small 3D figure generated live from your own Minecraft skin — head, body, arms, and legs, all pulled from the skin you're actually wearing. It's fully client-side and automatic: every player who installs it sees a mini version of *themselves*, no setup required.

## Features

- **Built from your real skin** — the totem becomes a little 3D you, generated at runtime from your current skin.
- **Shows up everywhere a totem does** — in your hand, in your inventory, dropped on the ground, and during the totem pop animation.
- **The pop still pops** — when a totem saves your life, you get the classic spin/flash animation… as a tiny you.
- **Truly per-player** — your friends see their own skins, you see yours. Nothing is tied to one account.
- **Client-side only** — works on any server, even ones you don't own. Other players don't need the mod.
- **Set it and forget it** — installs, detects your skin, and just works.

## Commands

- `/totemavatar refresh` — rebuild the totem after you change your skin.-
*Made by ERTZ.*
